About us

We are a community-led charity based in Uganda, guided by Islamic values of mercy, generosity and service. Our team works directly with the families we support, so donors abroad can trust that their gift is used where it matters most.

100Orphans supported
60Families given food packages
5Wheelchairs given

So far. Many more people still need food and wheelchairs, and limited funds are all that holds us back. Your gift helps us reach them.

What we do

Food packages

Food packs delivered to poor and needy families.

Orphan support

Regular food and care for orphans.

Wheelchairs

Wheelchairs for disabled and vulnerable people who cannot walk.

Ramadan feeding

Iftar and food for poor Muslims who are fasting.

Qurbani

Qurbani performed on your behalf, with the meat shared among the poor.

Duas for donors

We make dua for our donors. Contact us to have a dua made for you or someone you love.

Clean Water Tap Project

Many families in our communities have no safe water. A clean tap protects children from disease and gives families time to learn and work. Give clean water, give life.

1 tap: €160

One clean water tap for a community

Double tap: €200

Two taps, so twice as many families drink safe water

After you donate
1. Send a screenshot of your receipt and the transfer reference number on WhatsApp.
2. Tell us your name as you want it written on our banner, or ask to stay anonymous.
3. Tell us what your gift is for (orphans, food, wheelchair, water, Qurbani).
4. When we distribute, we hold a banner with your name and send you the photo or video.

Thank you, and your questions

We make dua for every donor and their families. Jazakumullahu khayran for your kindness.

Can I choose what my gift is used for?

Yes. When you message us, tell us your intention, such as orphans, food packages, wheelchairs, water taps, Ramadan feeding or Qurbani.

How will I know my gift reached people?

We send you photos or video from the distribution on WhatsApp, and we also post on TikTok.

How do I send money from abroad?

Use Western Union, Ria or MoneyGram to Kenneth Nakisisa, Uganda, then send us the transfer reference number on WhatsApp +256 741 344 006. Bank transfer and mobile money are also available.

Is the organization registered?

Our registration is in progress. Until it is complete, donations are received through our coordinator’s account, and we welcome any question about how funds are used.

Can you make dua for me or my family?

Yes, message us on WhatsApp with the names and we will make dua for you.
